name: fullstack-agents
description: Unified fullstack development toolkit with 28 AI agents, 8 commands, and 16 skill domains for FastAPI, Next.js, Docker, Celery, WebSocket, and more. Auto-triggers via SessionStart hook with enforced validation gates (PostToolUse ruff, Stop ruff+tsc+file-size) and a senior-engineer discipline for duplication prevention and clean architecture. Features intelligent code generation with interactive dialogue, pattern detection, and multi-agent orchestration.
